newsitem.title: GREECE: CASINO MAGIC MAY CLOSE CASINO IN GREECE.
newsitem.headline: CASINO MAGIC MAY CLOSE CASINO IN GREECE.

text.p: Casino Magic Corp said on Thursday it was considering closing "in the very near future" its casino in Porto Carras, Greece, because it has been performing badly.
The company, which has a 49 percent equity interest in the casino, attributed the losses to the opening of a competing casino in September.
Casino Magic said that while it expected some losses, the actual effects were much greater than expected and resulted in Porto Carras's loss of $2.0 million in September.

"Despite new marketing and cost-containment efforts, these losses have continued; furthermore, the majority owner in the Porto Carras venture has been unwilling or unable to advance any funds to the operation," Casino Magic said.
Casino Magic also said the majority owner has decided against operating a substantial portion of the resort in 1997.
Because of these and other factors, Casino Magic said, it plans to write off its investment in the casino. It said options include a sale or liquidation of its stake in the casino.
Casino Magic today reported third quarter losses of 0.57 per share. It said the losses included write-offs associated with the Porto Carras casino operation.
